name: Nebraska Public Power District
old_description: Before heading into the field, review your work practices that take place around any power lines. Remember to look up and around.
about:
Nebraska Public Power District (NPPD) is a publicly-owned utility headquartered in Columbus, Nebraska. It was formed on January 1, 1970, through the merger of Consumers Public Power District, Platte Valley Public Power and Irrigation District, and Nebraska Public Power System. As a political subdivision of the State of Nebraska, NPPD is governed by an 11-member Board of Directors elected from its chartered territory, which spans all or parts of 84 of the state's 93 counties.

NPPD generates, transmits, and distributes electric power across its service territory. Its generation portfolio includes wind, coal, hydroelectric, nuclear, and natural gas facilities, providing a diverse mix of baseload and renewable energy. The utility operates customer service centers throughout the state, offering call answering, dispatch, and start/stop services for both NPPD and partner utilities. It serves more than 95,000 retail customers directly and provides wholesale power to 35 municipalities and 23 public power districts or cooperatives.

The district's customers include residential, commercial, agricultural, and industrial users across 81 Nebraska communities. Wholesale partners include municipal utilities such as those in Norfolk and other cities, as well as rural electric cooperatives. NPPD also administers energy efficiency programs like EnergyWise, which offers incentives for smart thermostats and lawn equipment.

NPPD's founding merger was driven by a desire to consolidate public power resources and ensure reliable, affordable electricity for Nebraskans. The utility emphasizes its public-power model—local control, not-for-profit operation, and a commitment to community investment—as its defining difference from investor-owned utilities.

name: Nelson Steel Products Inc
old_description: Our facility provides a complete range of steel fabrication capabilities, including robotic welding and laser cutting.
about:
Nelson Steel Products Inc operates from Holland, Michigan. The company traces its roots to 1945 when Nelson Ryzenga opened Ryzenga Welding and Steel Works, a welding repair shop serving local farmers. By 1959 the business incorporated as Nelson Steel Products, Inc., and a 1968 U.S. Army trailer-frame contract spurred expansion into a large-scale production facility. The company remains family-led, with the founder's sons Wally and Roger involved in its growth.

The shop provides a full range of steel fabrication services: robotic welding across 13 stations housing 17 robots, sheet and tube laser cutting, stamping and turret punching on high-volume presses, press-brake forming, tube bending, and custom prototyping. The facility is equipped for high-volume punching and stamping runs, though total square footage and headcount are not disclosed.

Early work centered on agricultural implements, and the 1968 government contract established a military track record. Today the company serves a broader industrial base in the Midwest, positioning itself as a single source for fabricated steel components, though specific current sectors beyond agriculture and defense are not detailed in public materials.

Nelson Steel emphasizes integrity and problem-solving as its differentiators, citing decades of experience since 1945 and a "can-do attitude" that aims to make it a partner rather than just a vendor. The company's mission statement targets manufacturing in fabricated metal components with on-time delivery of total-quality products.

name: Netech Corporation
old_description: The pioneer and leading manufacturer of easy-to-use biomedical test equipments.
about:
Netech Corporation, headquartered in Farmingdale, New York, has been designing and manufacturing biomedical test equipment since 1987. The company operates as an SBA 8(a)‑certified small business and holds a GSA contract (V797P‑4228B) with the Veterans Administration. All instruments are produced in the United States.

The product line spans defibrillator analyzers, electrical safety analyzers, pressure meters, patient simulators (including ECG, EEG, and SpO₂ waveform generation), gas flow analyzers, infusion pump analyzers, and dedicated pacemaker analyzers such as the EXPMT 2000. Netech’s engineering team develops new models in‑house — recent additions include the MiniSim EEG 2000 multi‑channel EEG simulator — and every unit ships with a NIST‑traceable calibration certificate backed by a two‑year warranty.

Primary customers are biomedical engineering departments, medical‑device manufacturers, hospitals, and federal agencies, notably the Veterans Administration through the GSA schedule. The company’s defibrillator and pacemaker analyzers carry FDA 510(k) clearance, and all devices are FDA listed and CE marked for international distribution.

Netech states its mission is to deliver the highest‑quality medical test instruments at the right price, emphasizing innovation, proactive customer service, and uncompromising quality. The firm highlights its ISO 9001‑registered quality system, domestic manufacturing, and included NIST calibration as key differentiators that reduce risk for biomedical professionals.

name: Neuweg Industries LLC
old_description: Striving to be your partner for fabrication and machining solutions.
about:
Neuweg Industries LLC operates from Milnor, North Dakota. The company provides fabrication and machining services, though its founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed. It positions itself as a partner for metal fabrication and machining solutions.

The shop runs a range of metalworking processes: flat laser cutting, tube laser cutting on a 3D machine equipped with both a bundle loader for high-volume runs and a single bar loader for small batches, press brake forming using CNC hydraulic brakes with CAD/CAM programming, and CNC machining that covers milling, turning, routing, and sawing. Welding capacity includes both manual stations and robotic cells. Tube bending is handled on an NC rotary draw bender suited for pipe, tube, square, rectangular, and solid profiles up to large diameters. Additional services include sheet and tube rolling, plus finishing and deburring to remove sharp edges. The facility supports bar feed up to 3 inches in diameter and 4 feet in length, with Y-axis capability on its machining centers.

Neuweg serves customers needing precision metal fabrication and machining, though specific industry sectors are not listed in its public materials. Its equipment mix suggests work for agricultural, construction, energy, and general industrial markets that require laser-cut sheet metal, formed components, welded assemblies, and bent tubing.

The company states it is committed to outstanding customer service and superior products, aiming to be a responsive partner that uses advanced planning tools to react promptly to customer needs.

name: Nevada Business Furniture
old_description: Browse online products—our team is dedicated to supporting you every step of the way.
about:
Nevada Business Furniture, based in Las Vegas, Nevada, has served the Las Vegas Valley since 2010. Founded as a one-stop shop for office furniture, cubicle workstations, interior design, and space planning, the company operates as a dealer for major commercial brands, supplying everything from call-center cubicles and electric standing desks to reception desks and ergonomic chairs.

Beyond product sales, the firm provides on-site space planning with an ergonomic focus, 2-D and 3-D design renderings, delivery coordinated around client schedules, and professional installation that includes debris removal. It also offers financing through partners and manages custom furniture projects from concept through assembly.

The customer base includes home offices, small businesses, and medium-sized companies throughout Southern Nevada and surrounding areas such as St. George, Utah; Barstow, California; Kingman, Arizona; and Bullhead City, Arizona.

The company states its mission is to deliver the same service, pricing, and solutions typically reserved for large corporations, emphasizing customer service, cost effectiveness, and tailored solutions as its three core values.

name: New Earth Solar
old_description: Fully-featured solar sales enablement & project fulfillment platform with push-button simplicity!
about:
New Earth Solar, based in Newark, Delaware, was founded by Davis Pfund, a BPI Certified Home Energy Auditor with over 13 years of experience in green energy programs and renewable energy incentives. Pfund grew up working for his family's energy efficiency business, Zerodraft Maryland, which partnered with utility companies across the mid-Atlantic. He launched the New Earth Solar Team (NEST) to deliver a holistic approach to renewable energy, focusing on custom whole-home solutions with battery backup protection.

The company brokers solar and energy efficiency solutions nationwide, partnering with brands such as Tesla, Enphase, SolarEdge, Franklin WH, REC, and QCell for panels, inverters, and batteries. It also offers EV charger and smart panel installations, flexible financing with $0 down options, and guidance on tax credits and incentives.

The firm serves homeowners, business owners, and multi-family property managers seeking residential, commercial, and multi-family solar installations, as well as energy efficiency upgrades. Its consultant-led process begins with an energy bill review, followed by a discovery call, a custom proposal, plan selection, and installation management.

New Earth Solar emphasizes authenticity, integrity, and transparency, aiming to help clients achieve energy independence and financial savings while supporting environmental causes. Through its Powur partnership, the company offers a 30-year warranty covering roof penetrations, inverters, and panels, and directs a portion of each installation toward Amazon rainforest preservation.

name: New England Fabrics & Decorating Center
old_description: The region's largest family owned Fabric & Decorating Center!
about:
New England Fabrics & Decorating Center operates in Keene, New Hampshire, a tax-free shopping destination. The family-owned business has served the greater Keene and Central New England community for nearly nine decades.

The retailer maintains a 17,000-square-foot showroom organized into nine departments, stocking thousands of fabrics for interior and home décor, window treatments, upholstery, quilting, and fashion, along with yarns, sewing machines, notions, and foam rubber. The store also functions as a made-to-order headquarters for custom window treatments, blinds, and upholstery.

Customers include quilters, fashion sewists, home decorators, and interior designers seeking fabric yardage, sewing supplies, and custom soft furnishings. The center hosts a quilt guild, offers classes, and provides a full line of sewing machines for in-store trial.

The company emphasizes its scale and longevity as differentiators, positioning itself as the region's largest family-owned fabric and decorating center with a comprehensive selection under one roof.

name: New England Motor Racing Supply
old_description: Welcome to New England Motor Racing Supply’s New Online Store.
about:
New England Motor Racing Supply (NEMRS) was founded in 1992 in Hollis, New Hampshire. The company began as a supplier of Supermodified racing parts and has since become a builder of ISMA Supermodified chassis.

NEMRS supplies a wide range of racing components and builds complete ISMA Supermodified chassis. Some of the products offered are manufactured by its sister company, Valley Welding & Fabrication, while others are sourced from various brands. The operation runs from a facility on Proctor Hill Road, open seven days a week.

The business serves the motorsports industry, specifically Supermodified racing teams and drivers competing in ISMA-sanctioned events. Its customer base includes race teams seeking chassis fabrication and parts supply for high-performance oval-track competition.

NEMRS distinguishes itself through its long-standing focus on Supermodified racing, with over 25 years as a parts supplier and a reputation as a top ISMA chassis builder. The connection to Valley Welding & Fabrication adds in-house manufacturing capability for select components.
